title: ReplayPredicateV1
description: The predicate of an in-toto Statement v1 with predicateType https://uor.foundation/prism/replay/v1. The statement has exactly one subject, the Core-Wasm guest blob. The predicate names the runtime that re-executed the histories, the model of the build, every history by digest, and how many events diverged. It holds no clock, so the same replay writes the same bytes. Design: docs/proposals/284-histories-replay.md. Digests are lowercase hex without an algorithm prefix.

runtime.description: The runtime that re-executed the histories.

model.description: The model blob of the build that was replayed. sha256 is model_id; blake3 is the label of the blob without blake3:.

histories.description: Every history that was replayed. A statement that replayed nothing claims nothing, so at least one is required.

digest.description: Both digests cover the canonical JSON of the history, with no trailing newline.

events.description: Events re-executed. A history holds at least one.

divergences.description: Events whose outcome differs from the recording.

divergenceCount.description: The sum of histories[].divergences. A check rejects a statement where they disagree, and anything but zero withholds P3.

PrismDigestSet.description: Exactly sha256 and blake3, lowercase hex, over the same bytes (ADR-015). blake3 is default-mode BLAKE3 with 256-bit output.
